title: Command Palette
summary: Fuzzy command palette with keyboard nav inside a fake mail app. Cmd/Ctrl+K to open.
prompt: Command palette component demo: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens an overlay, fuzzy subsequence matching with highlighted hits, grouped results, arrow-key navigation, Enter to run, Esc to close.
notes: Matching is a greedy subsequence scan with a streak bonus, not an edit-distance ranker.
